*AI-written, 11 November 2026. A page of [the laws and tests behind the map](LEDGER.md), the layer under [the map](THE-MAP.md).*

For each of the 19 drawn ties and each role, one law for each question that has one, with its main conditions. Read a law with its conditions: without them it says more than was proved. Every law of a place is on [the ledger to operate](https://yongxu.github.io/theories/theories/becoming/results/map/the-web.html) and in the atlas entry linked beside it.

- *exactly where*: if and only if. *enough for it*: where the conditions hold, it follows. *needed for it*: it holds only where they do. *one built case*: an example that shows it can happen, not a general law.
- A condition is given by the name the atlas's ledger gives it; the ledger has its statement.
- A general law is quoted before a built case, and an exact one before one that is only enough.
- *If something given were changed*: a law that says what would follow if something its model holds fixed were changed from outside. It answers none of the four questions of the course itself and fills no square.

## The ties

<a id="tie-draws-on-drawers-stock"></a>
### the drawers · draws on · a stock

取用者 · 取 · 存量. Takes from a stock, step by step, against what comes back. [80 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-draws-on-drawers-stock) speak of it; its 34 principal laws come from 25 of them.

- **What makes it last**. Where two drawers have no floor, in every perfect profile every drawer leaves exactly its floor at every step before the horizon, from every level. *If:* a drawer with no floor; two drawers in order; InTurn.Perfect; and 2 more. *(enough for it; of the best of what is open; `Optimum.InTurn.perfect_at_floors`, [Several drawers: drawers in turn and at once](../atlas/families/b.md#drawers-in-turn))*
- **What makes it end**. It is not so that at arbitrarily late steps some formation draws on or gives back to a condition; no last step is named. *If:* enclosed around what stands from T on, unrefuted; dissipation; balance; a census of what stands. *(enough for it; `World.exchange_not_recurring`, [The rest theorem](../atlas/families/g.md#continued-change-needs-openness))*
- **What keeps it from beginning**. Every optimum draws nothing at each step to the n-th after which the rising level is still below y, and stands at that level. *If:* rising with the weighted draw; the weighted gain rising strictly up to y; a level of greatest weighted gain; the rising course below y; and 7 more. *(enough for it; of the best of what is open; `Optimum.frontier_rebuilds`, [Every optimum rebuilds a depleted base](../atlas/families/h.md#optima-rebuild-a-depleted-base))*
- **Where the line falls** (10 laws). The joint process executes a course exactly where each draw is within the stock then standing and the other process admits the course. *(exactly where; `Stock.product_feasible_iff`, [Which selections survive and remain executable when the lumping changes](../atlas/families/d.md#selection-when-the-lumping-changes))*
- **What it is unmoved by** (4 laws). The drawer stays consuming under every change of its own dependence from T₀ on, exactly where it consumes through a dependence left unchanged. *(exactly where; of two courses that differ in one thing; `Web.consumingIn_kept_iff`, [A consumer that switches stays consuming, on the whole-run reading](../atlas/families/a.md#substitution-preserves-consumption))*
- **An order that is kept**. Under a proportional draw the return multiplier tends to one from below as the draw rises to the renewal rate. *If:* a positive step length. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `SlowingDown.drawnMultiplier_tendsto`, [Slowing down before a condition's own end](../atlas/families/a.md#slowing-down-before-an-own-end))*
- **What cannot happen** (7 laws). No other drawer takes from the stock at every step of any run of steps one longer than its level at the start. *If:* TakesAll; f active at every step; a need of at least m; the gate at need m; and 6 more. *(enough for it; `Flow.continuing_excludes`, [What taking all that is given excludes](../atlas/families/b.md#what-taking-all-excludes))*
- **Read backward: what holding it shows** (6 laws). What is left above the floor, where leaving it draws no less than leaving the floor, returns later at least one for one. *If:* leaving r draws no less than leaving the floor; and 2 more. *(enough for it; of the best of what is open; `Optimum.InTurn.kept_returns`, [Several drawers: drawers in turn and at once](../atlas/families/b.md#drawers-in-turn))*
- **The same as, in another model**. At each step the carrier's market state is the market's own step, with the fee raised by the migration cost. *(enough for it; `AlignmentSuccession.exact_market_projection`, [Succession on a carrier provided for migration](../atlas/families/h.md#succession-on-a-funded-carrier))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin or change.
- **If something given were changed** (2 laws). At some step the level is zero with no holder and no other left; until then the state stays in the family. *If:* a constant take over the renewal; an excess of at least one; a family closed under the steps that do not end; the start in the family. *(enough for it; `RuleRebuilding.«恒取逾生则尽»`, [A rule rebuilt from the members it limits](../atlas/families/h.md#a-rule-rebuilt-from-the-members-it-limits))*

*The same tie between what depends on it and a stock* (2 dynamics, 1 law):

- **The same as, in another model**. The held stock's level is a reserve for its holder at every step: no rise while unsupported, a fall where active then. *If:* a held condition unreplenished; a held condition drawn while active; balance. *(enough for it; `Flow.carries_of_held`, [A reserve defers the end](../atlas/families/a.md#reserve-defers-ending))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last, change or end.

*The same tie between what goes on and a stock* (1 dynamic, 1 law):

- **Read backward: what holding it shows**. In the built process an ignition shows the reserve was present before the move and is used up after it. *If:* an ignition move. *(one built case; `SeededContinuation.ignition_requires_actual_reserve`, [A circular dependence: maintenance running or a wait no one can begin](../atlas/families/e.md#a-circular-wait-needs-a-reserve-present))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last, change or end.

*The same tie between what it selects among and a stock* (1 dynamic, 1 law):

- **An order that is kept**. At every step the course that started not lower, with its readers' bound not higher, is not lower in share, loss and rule. *If:* selection monotone; the drain monotone; the readers' reading monotone; the readers never above the share-readers; and 5 more. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `PoolFromCourse.window_order_kept`, [The lock draws its readers out](../atlas/families/c.md#the-lock-draws-its-readers-out))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last, change or end.

<a id="tie-gives-back-renewer-stock"></a>
### what gives back · gives back to · a stock

补给者 · 补 · 存量. Gives to a stock; how it answers the level (at once, late, only above a need). [78 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-gives-back-renewer-stock) speak of it; its 19 principal laws come from 13 of them.

- **What makes it last**. Along the run, giving back to the stock recurs: from every step on, some step gives back a positive amount. *If:* Stock.Balanced; draws at arbitrarily late steps. *(enough for it; `Run.replenishes_of_draws`, [Activity forms reference revision and makes it recur](../atlas/families/h.md#recurring-reference-revision))*
- **Where the line falls** (2 laws). The joint exchange is within the level's gap to m exactly where the next level lies between m and the present level. *If:* balanced on the family over a stretch. *(exactly where; `Flow.withinGap_iff_between`, [Two-sided regulation, and regulation that reads late](../atlas/families/h.md#two-sided-regulation-and-late-reading))*
- **An order that is kept**. At a fold the return multiplier tends to one from below as the margin to the stock's own end shrinks to nothing. *If:* a positive step length. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `SlowingDown.foldMultiplier_tendsto`, [Slowing down before a condition's own end](../atlas/families/a.md#slowing-down-before-an-own-end))*
- **What cannot happen** (4 laws). For every bound R and every step, the family's replenishment does not stay at or below R from that step on. *If:* balance; more without end; natural-number amounts. *(enough for it; `Flow.More.replenishment_unbounded`, [More needs more renewers; unceasing arising needs renewal](../atlas/families/h.md#more-needs-renewers))*
- **Read backward: what holding it shows** (6 laws). From the step of balance on, no bound holds on how many entries of the present list give back to the family. *If:* keeping widening; taking while supported (upkeep); balance on the family from a step; bounded giving per entry. *(enough for it; `Web.KeepsWidening.renewers_unbounded`, [What keeping widening needs, and what carries it](../atlas/families/g.md#what-keeping-widening-needs))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, change or end.
- **If something given were changed** (5 laws). After the first step the rate of giving back is below its initial value at every step: the keeping ends at once, for good. *If:* a positive initial rate; pressure beyond the rate at the first step; a supplied wear law with no recovery. *(enough for it; `RenewingFormation.beyond_loses_capacity_at_once`, [Renewing and consuming formation](../atlas/families/h.md#renewing-consuming-formation))*

<a id="tie-needs-dependent-stock"></a>
### what depends on it · needs · a stock

依者 · 需 · 存量. Depends on a stock at a need; the margin above it; the point past which the level does not come back. [65 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-needs-dependent-stock) speak of it; its 65 principal laws come from 35 of them.

- **What makes it begin**. The level is at or above the sustaining need at step T + (needG − level at T): the sustaining need is met then. *If:* the repair route supported; contribution above the draw; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `SupportGated.repair_restores`, [Supported repair and reformation of a sustaining relation](../atlas/families/h.md#supported-renewal-recovery))*
- **What makes it last** (6 laws). Under a cut the stock buys the reader time, with an end from an empty stock, exactly where the rebuild draws on the level. *If:* at least one unit wanted; a span of at least one. *(exactly where; of two courses that differ in one thing; `ReaderRebuilding.«以储买时当且仅当取于储»`, [A reader rebuilt from the level it reads: its end does not come back](../atlas/families/a.md#a-reader-rebuilt-from-its-stock-ends-with-it))*
- **What makes it end** (11 laws). At erosion 1/2, unshocked, the guarded course from each start near the depleting end stops at some step, whatever its starting support. *If:* in the box about the depletion end; a small box about the depletion end; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `RegimeAttraction.low_guarded_history_fails`, [The market model's share, margin and ends](../atlas/families/a.md#market-model-share-margin-and-ends))*
- **What keeps it from beginning** (3 laws). No member of the family is supported at any step from T on: support does not begin in the family. *If:* no member supported at T; requirements that do not loosen; only members giving to what members require; balance; and 3 more. *(enough for it; `Flow.unsupported_stays`, [Support passed on by later gainers](../atlas/families/h.md#support-passed-on))*
- **Where the line falls** (21 laws). A dependence on a stock beyond is broken across the step exactly where some eligible outcome leaves that stock below its need. *If:* Rising; Room; each condition beyond depended on at a need met; on the frontier (an optimum); and 1 more. *(exactly where; of the best of what is open; `Web.optimum_broken_iff`, [What an optimum does beyond what couples in](../atlas/families/b.md#what-an-optimum-does-beyond-what-couples-in))*
- **What it is unmoved by**. Given the record, the share of courses where the level falls to the need within the n steps left equals the share from m′. *If:* the record shows the margin left. *(enough for it; of every course of every process; `ConditionalWeights.record_share`, [The exit from a margin](../atlas/families/a.md#exit-from-a-margin))*
- **An order that is kept** (4 laws). A dependent lost beyond a region (admitted by one course's levels, not the other's) is lost beyond every region inside it. *If:* a region inside another; loss beyond a region. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `Web.LosesBeyond.narrow`, [Loss beyond a region](../atlas/families/b.md#loss-beyond-a-region))*
- **What cannot happen** (3 laws). No optimum keeps the stock at or above the need at every step through the horizon. *If:* a coupling of keeping at most w; a coupling below what keeping forgoes; renewal at or above the need at most q; r given at the level held; and 8 more. *(enough for it; of the best of what is open; `Optimum.frontier_breaks_below`, [What keeping forgoes, and a coupling against it](../atlas/families/b.md#keeping-forgoes-the-renewal-at-the-need))*
- **Read backward: what holding it shows** (3 laws). Being active at a step is kept along every chain of positive need on embodied stocks, from the dependent to what it needs. *If:* activity needing support. *(enough for it; `Web.active_along`, [Co-ending along dependence](../atlas/families/a.md#co-ending-along-dependence))*
- **The same as, in another model** (4 laws). The zero amount is a reserve exactly where every dependent is active only while its needs are met. *(exactly where; `Web.carries_zero`, [A reserve defers the end](../atlas/families/a.md#reserve-defers-ending))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it change.
- **If something given were changed** (8 laws). For each positive share some N: stock at least the cover K_N carries the guarded run through N steps; then, unshocked, it never stops. *If:* a nonnegative support cost; a physical state; a positive renewing share. *(enough for it; `RegimeTransition.supported_finite_transition`, [Draining: below a drained level no history lasts](../atlas/families/a.md#market-finite-support-obstruction))*

*The same tie between its readers and a stock* (3 dynamics, 4 laws):

- **What makes it last** (2 laws). Under a cut the stock buys the reader time, with an end from an empty stock, exactly where the rebuild draws on the stock. *If:* at least one unit wanted; a span of at least one. *(exactly where; `ReaderRebuilding.«以储买时当且仅当取于储»`, [The stock buys time where the rebuild draws on it](../atlas/families/h.md#the-stock-buys-time-where-the-rebuild-draws-on-it))*
- **What keeps it from beginning**. With the level empty and the reader gone, every step, supplied or not, leaves both so: on every course neither returns. *If:* a reader rebuilt from the level. *(enough for it; `ReaderRebuilding.«取于储者绝而不复»`, [The stock buys time where the rebuild draws on it](../atlas/families/h.md#the-stock-buys-time-where-the-rebuild-draws-on-it))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, change or end.
- **If something given were changed** (1 law). Where the reader is gone after a step, the level after that step is zero. *If:* a reader rebuilt from the level; the reader gone after the step; at least one unit wanted. *(needed for it; `ReaderRebuilding.«读者绝则无储»`, [The stock buys time where the rebuild draws on it](../atlas/families/h.md#the-stock-buys-time-where-the-rebuild-draws-on-it))*

<a id="tie-selects-rule-selected"></a>
### a rule · selects and favours · what it selects among

规则 · 选 · 所选者. The rule picks among them and favours some. Where it keeps favouring what it picked, that is the lock. [46 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-selects-rule-selected) speak of it; its 76 principal laws come from 30 of them.

- **What makes it begin** (4 laws). The share falls at no step; the lock begins by the step after the first reading step and is there after every later one. *If:* Raises; ReadsShare, on the rule; the reading favours at every share; the rule at the start favours. *(enough for it; `RuleCapture.favouring_locks`, [Capture through the rule](../atlas/families/c.md#capture-through-the-rule))*
- **What makes it last** (17 laws). The renewing share is higher at the next step. *If:* a positive private advantage; a share above none; a share below all; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `MarketGenerativity.share_strictly_increases`, [The market model's share, margin and ends](../atlas/families/a.md#market-model-share-margin-and-ends))*
- **What makes it end**. At the next step the region's carriers are as many as the revisions into it: its passing on from carriers stops here. *If:* a family drawn below the need; the carriers requiring the family; and 4 more. *(enough for it; `Flow.carriers_drawn_down`, [Readings revised at descent: a share moving by selection and revision, locked where closed under revision](../atlas/families/h.md#readings-revised-spread-and-locked))*
- **What keeps it from beginning** (5 laws). Over any number of steps the carriers are not selected for in that cohort, whatever laws of giving they hold and whatever the errors. *If:* β at most γ; a cohort listed in pairs; places not of the kind withhold. *(enough for it; `PairSelection.never_rises_in_pairs`, [Offspring read from giving that waits](../atlas/families/e.md#offspring-read-from-giving-that-waits))*
- **Where the line falls** (24 laws). Across a generation of wholes the mean founding value rises exactly where the rule among wholes favours it. *If:* wholes founded by one part; sequestered. *(exactly where; `Founding.Nested.raises_iff_among`, [A confined rise within a whole](../atlas/families/a.md#confined-rise-within-a-whole))*
- **What it is unmoved by** (7 laws). Up to a step, every selection through a reader's couplings selects two histories alike exactly where they are alike in all that reader reads. *(exactly where; of two courses that differ in one thing; `Web.selects_alike_iff`, [Selection blind beyond the coupling closure](../atlas/families/b.md#unselected-beyond-the-coupling-closure))*
- **What cannot happen** (4 laws). No course has two steps where the late reading favours the others strictly at the step's share and the carriers strictly at the next. *If:* each kind of reader for its own; the late reading does not favour the shapers at a step; the late reading does not favour the others at the next step; and 5 more. *(enough for it; `ReadInTime.at_most_one_between`, [The loss read in time by the others, joined to the critical mass](../atlas/families/c.md#loss-read-in-time-by-the-others))*
- **Read backward: what holding it shows** (3 laws). Some strict order according with the choices ranks every alternative that does not end above every ending one met with it. *If:* the line persists; an ending choice realized as an overdraw; choices from some strict order; every cohort coupled to the family; and 5 more. *(enough for it; `Flow.persisting_keeping_above_ending`, [Persisting is a filter on what was chosen: keeping above ending, on the occasions met](../atlas/families/h.md#persisting-filters-what-was-chosen))*
- **The same as, in another model**. Read as generations of descent, the first step is balanced, selection against what transmission lowers, exactly where c·m + d·w equals d·k. *If:* carriers present. *(exactly where; `Reproduction.Mutation.balanced_iff`, [Mutation and the balance it sets](../atlas/families/h.md#mutation-and-the-balance-it-sets))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it change.
- **If something given were changed** (10 laws). Drawing everything is perfect exactly where, before the last step, no portion returns more than one for one on what its drawer alone leaves. *(exactly where; of the best of what is open; `Optimum.AtOnce.drain_perfect_iff`, [Several drawers: drawers in turn and at once](../atlas/families/b.md#drawers-in-turn))*

<a id="tie-is-of-reading-subject"></a>
### a reading · is of, and accords or misses · what it is of

读法 · 合／不合 · 所读者. The reading accords with what it is of, or misses; what it can and cannot tell apart. [31 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-is-of-reading-subject) speak of it; its 31 principal laws come from 19 of them.

- **What makes it begin** (4 laws). At the next step the hearer's code gives the two senses different forms, though the imposed code merges them. *If:* a form kept outside the imposition; the hearing at the step; the hearer holds the imposed form; the imposed code merges two senses; and 3 more. *(enough for it; `SharedCodes.outside_returns`, [A code formed between formations](../atlas/families/c.md#a-code-formed-between-formations))*
- **What makes it last** (7 laws). Such a reading admits every world possible after every history: the possible worlds are the least reading so kept. *If:* KeptBy; the starts read at the empty history; a world possible after the history. *(enough for it; `ReadingLoop.possible_least`, [A reading kept by its update, and the reading its own history carries](../atlas/families/d.md#a-reading-kept-by-its-update))*
- **What keeps it from beginning** (3 laws). At every step after the rest's n steps, the level reached is below the level the reading predicted at no risk. *If:* a preferred level at least the need; a choice at no risk; the rest outruns the renewal; a start below n + m; and 7 more. *(enough for it; `FreeEnergyGuarantees.RiskAndNeeds.expectation_not_course`, [Risk minimization on a shared renewal](../atlas/families/b.md#risk-minimization-on-a-shared-renewal))*
- **Where the line falls** (5 laws). Some family of readings within what it reads says every reading exactly where no two values differ. *If:* decided. *(exactly where; `Diagonal.complete_iff_alike`, [A family of readings within what it reads](../atlas/families/d.md#readings-within-what-they-read))*
- **What it is unmoved by** (2 laws). Two profiles of amounts give every part the same position exactly where each part's amount differs between them by one common amount. *(exactly where; of two courses that differ in one thing; `RelativePosition.keeps_iff_common`, [Position does not protect](../atlas/families/b.md#position-does-not-protect))*
- **What cannot happen** (5 laws). No published prediction is right: whichever value is published, the outcome differs from it. *If:* the response moves every value. *(enough for it; `ReflexivePrediction.none_right_of_moves`, [A prediction read by what it predicts](../atlas/families/d.md#a-prediction-read-by-what-it-predicts))*
- **Read backward: what holding it shows** (4 laws). The margin to the fold is read exactly from the return multiplier a: m = ((1 − a)/(2h))². *If:* a margin not below the fold; a positive step length. *(enough for it; `SlowingDown.fold_margin_read`, [Slowing down before a condition's own end](../atlas/families/a.md#slowing-down-before-an-own-end))*
- **The same as, in another model**. With every formation a center, each center's own closure, along affecting or being affected, holds every continuation exactly where the flow is mutually dependent. *If:* every formation a center. *(exactly where; `Flow.mutuallyDependent_iff_unrestricted`, [Mutual dependence, and the exponential pace that loops of couplings give](../atlas/families/h.md#mutual-dependence-and-its-pace))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it change or end.

*The same tie between a reading and a reading* (2 dynamics, 4 laws):

- **What cannot happen** (2 laws). At every step, formations the exchange pairs hold different forms at the sense: agreement between them does not begin. *If:* KeepsExchange; KeepsRenaming; a symmetric start; the renaming moves every form. *(enough for it; `SharedCodes.never_agrees_of_both`, [A code formed between formations](../atlas/families/c.md#a-code-formed-between-formations))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last, change or end.
- **If something given were changed** (2 laws). After the order of hearings, all codes agree at the sense from every start, exactly where the order gives all formations one origin there. *If:* hearings that take the form heard; two forms that differ; and 1 more. *(exactly where; `SharedCodes.agrees_every_start_iff`, [A code formed between formations](../atlas/families/c.md#a-code-formed-between-formations))*

<a id="tie-passes-on-pattern-parts"></a>
### what goes on · goes on through its parts · its parts

延续者 · 传／守 · 部分. It goes on while its parts turn over (passes on), or with the same parts (keeps). [29 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-passes-on-pattern-parts) speak of it; its 48 principal laws come from 18 of them.

- **What makes it begin** (2 laws). In one built case the two stocks' total stays one at every step, and a part begins at arbitrarily late steps. *(one built case; `Recycle.closed_unceasing`, [A closed cycle sustains unceasing arising, without dissipation](../atlas/families/f.md#closed-cycle-without-dissipation))*
- **What makes it last** (10 laws). A goal lasts down every lineage keeping it until giving, from a carrying founder, exactly where it passes at every descent from a carrier. *(exactly where; `Flow.goal_descends_iff`, [A goal along a lineage, need drift along a lineage, and what descent can form](../atlas/families/h.md#what-a-lineage-carries))*
- **What makes it end** (7 laws). From the step after the excess on, a dependent needing the stock at m or more leaves no descendant across any step. *If:* the gate at need m; joint excess at the steps named; a start below n + m; a need of at least m; and 5 more. *(enough for it; `GroupEnding.Flow.excess_childless`, [Groups with less leave nothing; groups on one family end together](../atlas/families/a.md#selection-among-groups-by-ending))*
- **What keeps it from beginning** (3 laws). With the reader gone and the level empty, every step, supply on or off, leaves both so: neither returns on any course. *If:* a reader rebuilt from the level. *(enough for it; `ReaderRebuilding.«取于储者绝而不复»`, [A reader rebuilt from the level it reads: its end does not come back](../atlas/families/a.md#a-reader-rebuilt-from-its-stock-ends-with-it))*
- **Where the line falls** (7 laws). The grade lies strictly between zero and the number listed exactly where the some-part whole is active and the every-part whole is not. *If:* a whole of its parts; a whole of every part; and 1 more. *(exactly where; `Web.diminished_iff`, [A whole of every part ends with one part; the grade between it and a whole of some part](../atlas/families/a.md#a-whole-of-every-part))*
- **What cannot happen** (4 laws). Parts cannot begin at arbitrarily late steps: beginning does not go on without end; no last step is named. *If:* a quantity that never rises; every arising lowering the quantity; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `Web.dissipation_arising_not_recurring`, [A closed cycle sustains unceasing arising, without dissipation](../atlas/families/f.md#closed-cycle-without-dissipation))*
- **Read backward: what holding it shows** (4 laws). The whole's beginning across a step shows a part beginning across the same step. *If:* a whole of its parts; the whole arising. *(enough for it; `Web.Whole.arises_part`, [A whole persists through the arising of its parts](../atlas/families/h.md#whole-persists-through-generation))*
- **The same as, in another model**. The passing premise holds exactly where every occurrence carrying the pattern after a step has a predecessor (有前) under the pattern's class. *(exactly where; of every course of every process; `Web.byPassing_iff_hasPred`, [A pattern outlasting its carriers lasts through passing](../atlas/families/h.md#a-pattern-lasts-through-passing))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it change.

The gap at the stock stays within some polynomial in the steps, for every rule within the strengths, exactly where no loop lies upstream. *If:* the list holds every condition; listed; and 1 more. *(exactly where; of two courses that differ in one thing; `gap_polynomial_iff_no_loop`, [How loops form within the unfolding](../atlas/families/f.md#how-loops-form))*
- **What it is unmoved by**. Up to step T every other level is alike in the two courses, and the stock stands higher by the raise. *If:* a law reading the stock only below a threshold; the stock standing at the threshold before T; two histories alike at the start but at c; the stock raised at the start; and 5 more. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `break_carried_nowhere`, [How loops form within the unfolding](../atlas/families/f.md#how-loops-form))*
- **An order that is kept**. With the others' levels no lower, the stock's threshold is no higher. *If:* mutual support: each giving rises with what is left; the coupled step keeps a band; the others' levels not above; the higher profile within the band; and 2 more. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.threshold_falls`, [An end cascading along total dependence](../atlas/families/a.md#a-cascade-along-total-dependence))*
- **Read backward: what holding it shows**. Some link of the loop gives on, for some difference, less than it receives. *If:* a difference fallen below its start. *(enough for it; `LoopReturn.closing_needs_less`, [Whether a loop closes, keeps or widens a difference](../atlas/families/f.md#whether-a-loop-closes-a-difference))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it change.
- **If something given were changed** (2 laws). The coupling ends from some step on, for good, exactly where the response is zero at some amount passed. *If:* the response does not rise in what has passed; the coupling of d into c acts at each step; the level stands; and 1 more. *(exactly where; `Saturation.stops_iff`, [A coupling saturated by what it has carried](../atlas/families/g.md#a-coupling-saturated-by-what-it-has-carried))*

<a id="tie-crosses-pattern-stock"></a>
### what goes on · passes in or out · a stock

延续者 · 出入 · 存量. Whether anything passes between a part and the rest across a step. [4 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-crosses-pattern-stock) speak of it; its 2 principal laws come from 2 of them.

- **If something given were changed** (2 laws). Relata beginning at arbitrarily late steps shows that from no step on is every step enclosed. *If:* arising recurring (unceasing); dissipation; embodiment; a census; and 1 more. *(needed for it; `World.arising_opens`, [The rest theorem](../atlas/families/g.md#continued-change-needs-openness))*

*The same tie between its parts and what goes on* (1 dynamic, 3 laws):

- **What makes it end** (2 laws). With any one grown link cut, its two ends lie apart: the attached end is outside the other's closure under the remaining links. *If:* grown by attachment. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `Cuts.attached_link_separates`, [Growth by attachment, and what a cut returns](../atlas/families/h.md#growth-constrained-fragmentation))*
- **What it is unmoved by**. After one join, cutting a grown link changes no closure exactly where the join's ends lie one on each side of it. *If:* grown by attachment. *(exactly where; of two courses that differ in one thing; `Cuts.joined_cut_unchanged_iff`, [Growth by attachment, and what a cut returns](../atlas/families/h.md#growth-constrained-fragmentation))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last or change.

<a id="tie-crosses-stock-stock"></a>
### a stock · passes in or out · a stock

存量 · 出入 · 存量. Whether anything passes between a part and the rest across a step. [4 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-crosses-stock-stock) speak of it; its 3 principal laws come from 2 of them.

- **What cannot happen** (2 laws). No finite family without repetition, containing one taken from at arbitrarily late steps, is closed at every step from any step on. *If:* dissipation; taking from the family recurs; a family within a containing family; balance; and 2 more. *(enough for it; `Flow.Dissipative.opens`, [No finite part bears taking](../atlas/families/b.md#no-finite-part-bears-taking))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last, change or end.
- **If something given were changed** (1 law). At arbitrarily late steps the family is not closed across the step. *If:* keeping widening; needs fixed within a family; a flow gaining nothing on closed families; balance on the family from a step; and 1 more. *(needed for it; `Web.KeepsWidening.open_late`, [What keeping widening needs, and what carries it](../atlas/families/g.md#what-keeping-widening-needs))*

<a id="tie-reaches-subject-readers"></a>
### what it is of · reaches, or lies beyond · its readers

所读者 · 及／不及 · 读取者. A difference in one thing couples into another, or lies beyond it. The receiving end can be a rule, its readers, a reading, or another level. [4 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-reaches-subject-readers) speak of it; its 8 principal laws come from 4 of them.

- **What it is unmoved by** (6 laws). Two courses differing only in the world read the same values through a step exactly where both worlds answered each earlier act alike. *If:* the same internal part at the start; the same sensory part at the start; the same active part at the start. *(exactly where; of two courses that differ in one thing; `ReadingLoop.sensed_alike_iff`, [What a course chosen through its model does not test](../atlas/families/d.md#what-a-course-chosen-through-its-model-does-not-test))*
- **What cannot happen**. In the two named courses, under any rule choosing closed moves from the view, views are one and targets differ at every step. *If:* ClosedLocal. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `Generative.NormativeActivity.adaptive_closed_cannot_resolve`, [Adaptive closure: a reference changed outside what is retained is not resolved from the view](../atlas/families/d.md#adaptive-closure-cannot-resolve))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last, change or end.
- **If something given were changed** (1 law). Where every answer that differs breaks a task kept in the second world, the two courses read the same values at every step. *If:* breaks; kept; and 4 more. *(needed for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `ReadingLoop.alike_of_kept`, [What a course chosen through its model does not test](../atlas/families/d.md#what-a-course-chosen-through-its-model-does-not-test))*

<a id="tie-reaches-subject-reading"></a>
### what it is of · reaches, or lies beyond · a reading

所读者 · 及／不及 · 读法. A difference in one thing couples into another, or lies beyond it. The receiving end can be a rule, its readers, a reading, or another level. [4 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-reaches-subject-reading) speak of it; its 5 principal laws come from 3 of them.

- **What keeps it from beginning**. At no step of that course is the stop read, whatever the true sign: the stop lies beyond the reading. *If:* all predict a gain. *(enough for it; `HeldForReading.SignLoop.never_senses_stop`, [What holding an act for a reading is worth: a listing that fixes the sign and never meets the stop](../atlas/families/d.md#a-stop-passed-by-a-listing-that-fixes-the-sign))*
- **Where the line falls**. Every profile of takes with a step's positions takes more than is given exactly where the spread above the least take does. *If:* a least part; a formation taking part at the step. *(exactly where; `Flow.excess_iff_spread`, [Position does not protect](../atlas/families/b.md#position-does-not-protect))*
- **What it is unmoved by** (2 laws). Two courses starting alike in listing, valuation and answer, and reading the same before a step, are alike in all three at that step. *If:* the same internal part at the start; the same active part at the start; sensed alike before n; and 1 more. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `ListingValuation.through_sensed`, [A reading informed and revalued along one law: the updates commute, the courses do not](../atlas/families/d.md#a-reading-informed-and-revalued))*
- **What cannot happen**. For every bound, some profile of amounts keeping every position has a total above it: position sets no upper bound. *If:* a part of the family. *(enough for it; of every course of every process; `RelativePosition.keeps_exceeds`, [Position does not protect](../atlas/families/b.md#position-does-not-protect))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last, change or end.

<a id="tie-read-through-reading-readers"></a>
### a reading · is read through · its readers

读法 · 经…而读 · 读取者. Through what the rule or reading is read, and where those readers are drawn from. [4 dynamics](DYNAMICS.md#tie-read-through-reading-readers) speak of it; no principal law is written up on it yet.


## One role alone

221 principal laws are about one role alone: its level, its share, its course.

<a id="role-pattern"></a>
### what goes on

延续者. Anything that goes on as the same in some respect: a formation, a whole, a pattern carried by brief carriers, a line of descent, a practice. 48 principal laws, from 25 dynamics.

- **What makes it begin** (4 laws). Some relatum begins to be active at arbitrarily late steps exactly where some relatum stops being active at arbitrarily late steps. *If:* counted by a bound; the bound returns within K; decided. *(exactly where; `World.CountedBy.arising_iff_ceasing`, [Ceasing needs arising; under a bounded list the two keep pace](../atlas/families/g.md#ceasing-needs-arising))*
- **What makes it last** (13 laws). From step T on the whole of every part is active at every step exactly where every part is, at every step. *If:* a whole of every part. *(exactly where; `Web.AllWhole.persists_iff`, [A whole of every part ends with one part; the grade between it and a whole of some part](../atlas/families/a.md#a-whole-of-every-part))*
- **What makes it change**. The focal drawer lasts active at every step, consuming; its need moves to the alternative at some step; the sustaining dependent ends for good. *If:* drawing beyond renewal; the focal need within the sustaining need; the focal need met at the start; the focal formation depends; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `Substitution.persists_consuming`, [A consumer that switches stays consuming, on the whole-run reading](../atlas/families/a.md#substitution-preserves-consumption))*
- **What makes it end** (15 laws). The pattern's line from that occurrence ends on every branch. *If:* a class within activity; the line starts active; the start is not after the horizon; nothing reached at the horizon is active. *(enough for it; `Web.every_branch_ends_of_gone`, [Degeneration from a horizon](../atlas/families/a.md#degeneration-from-a-horizon))*
- **What keeps it from beginning** (4 laws). From a count of nothing the histories of k generations weigh wholly on a count of nothing: the first kind does not begin again. *(enough for it; of every course of every process; `Drift.sampled_none`, [The ends of drift absorb; fixation, with and without selection in the draw](../atlas/families/a.md#fixation-by-drift))*
- **Where the line falls** (5 laws). A course is recoverable, some feasible course agreeing so far keeping what is asked, exactly at the steps before its point of no return. *If:* the point of no return. *(exactly where; `NoReturnAt.recoverable_iff`, [Reading in time: a selection read off continuation reads a loss before its point of no return, or too late](../atlas/families/b.md#reading-a-loss-in-time))*
- **What it is unmoved by**. From related starts the two formations read the same values and take the same acts at every step. *If:* steps, observed; related starts. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `ReadingLoop.observed_alike`, [What a course chosen through its model does not test](../atlas/families/d.md#what-a-course-chosen-through-its-model-does-not-test))*
- **What cannot happen** (2 laws). Arising is not unceasing: it is not so that some formation begins to be active at arbitrarily late steps. *If:* a quantity that never rises; every arising lowering the quantity; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `Web.dissipation_arising_not_recurring`, [Unceasing arising needs renewal](../atlas/families/g.md#unceasing-generation-needs-renewal))*
- **If something given were changed** (3 laws). Taught from outside, holders begin at the next step; taught by members or not at all, there is none at the next step. *Its conditions are in its Lean statement; the atlas's ledger does not list them.* *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `RuleRebuilding.«三源之表»`, [The ends of a rule rebuilt from its members: no holder, and the end, do not return](../atlas/families/a.md#a-rule-with-no-holder-does-not-return))*

<a id="role-parts"></a>
### its parts

部分. What it is made of or carried by, which can turn over while it goes on. 3 principal laws, from 2 dynamics.

- **What makes it end**. With none arising from some step on, every part is inactive from one common step on: the parts end together. *If:* the active parts listed; a formation's activity ends; no part arises from N on. *(enough for it; `Web.Listed.end_without_arising`, [A whole drawing beyond renewal ends](../atlas/families/b.md#whole-drawing-beyond-renewal-ends))*
- **Where the line falls**. The grade after the step, with the count of parts that ceased, equals the grade before it with the count that arose. *If:* the grade; a count. *(enough for it; `Web.Grade.across_step`, [A whole of every part ends with one part; the grade between it and a whole of some part](../atlas/families/a.md#a-whole-of-every-part))*
- **Read backward: what holding it shows**. Some listed part ceases across that same step: active at it, not at the next. *If:* a whole of at least j parts; ceases. *(enough for it; `Web.AtLeastWhole.ceases_part`, [A whole of every part ends with one part; the grade between it and a whole of some part](../atlas/families/a.md#a-whole-of-every-part))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last or change.

<a id="role-stock"></a>
### a stock

存量. Something with a level that is drawn on and given to: what something lives on, a reserve, a loss counted as it grows. 114 principal laws, from 51 dynamics.

- **What makes it begin** (3 laws). The level crosses the band upward at its entry: it enters within one M of a and, carried ℓM further, passes b. *If:* a relay reading late; a start held; the ramp entering the band at k; the entry carried past b; and 4 more. *(enough for it; `Regulation.held_crosses`, [A relay reading late settles or leaves both ends without end](../atlas/families/f.md#late-relay-oscillates))*
- **What makes it last** (23 laws). From some step at most 3·hi + 3 on, the state is at rest: recent giving at the draw, or level below the draw. *If:* the adjustment rises; rests at the draw where the regime does; the adjusted step keeps a band; and 3 more. *(enough for it; `RegimeMargin.Adjusted.comes_to_rest`, [One law of exact thresholds, and the threshold in the plane of level and recent giving](../atlas/families/a.md#threshold-in-the-state-plane))*
- **What makes it change** (6 laws). The stock goes on; its level after the step is what the rest leaves less the drawers' joint capacity, or nothing. *If:* MutualBest; c beyond every optimizer's family; Rising; balance between the levels across the step; and 4 more. *(enough for it; of the best of what is open; `Optimum.mutual_beyond`, [Several optimizers](../atlas/families/b.md#several-optimizers-drain-by-their-joint-capacity))*
- **What makes it end** (18 laws). Two stocks each downstream of the other end together or not at all: one ends exactly where the other does. *If:* positive draws on dependents; downstream along dependence. *(exactly where; `RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.ends_together`, [An end cascading along total dependence](../atlas/families/a.md#a-cascade-along-total-dependence))*
- **What keeps it from beginning** (5 laws). The stock's level, once below m, is below m after each of the next n steps: it does not return. *If:* the gate at need m; givers supported; balanced on the family over a stretch; the level below m. *(enough for it; `Flow.stays_below_at`, [Loss of renewal for good](../atlas/families/a.md#loss-of-renewal-for-good))*
- **Where the line falls** (26 laws). From a start up to the top, the stock's level reaches nothing at some step exactly where the start is below H + y. *If:* giving short below y; giving meets the draw from y; nothing from nothing; the step keeps a band; and 3 more. *(exactly where; `RegimeMargin.ends_iff_below`, [The point of no return of a regime](../atlas/families/a.md#margin-of-a-regime))*
- **What it is unmoved by**. Up to step T, the course where both give at every step and the course where neither gives keep every level the same. *If:* both formations active before the step; both intend to give in the first run; neither intends to give in the second run; the same standings at the start; and 3 more. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `PairFlow.WhileStanding.runs_agree_until`, [What decides giving against keeping on a flow](../atlas/families/e.md#what-decides-giving-against-keeping-on-a-flow))*
- **An order that is kept** (3 laws). A larger recent giving up to the top has a threshold no higher. *If:* the adjustment rises; the adjusted step keeps a band; the first recent giving not above the second; the recent giving within the band. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `RegimeMargin.Adjusted.threshold_falls`, [One law of exact thresholds, and the threshold in the plane of level and recent giving](../atlas/families/a.md#threshold-in-the-state-plane))*
- **What cannot happen** (5 laws). It cannot be that from that step on no configuration of the stocks is had again after a change; no step is named. *If:* balance; the whole gains nothing across the step; the configuration changing at arbitrarily late steps. *(enough for it; `Flow.Balances.unending_change_revisits`, [Lossless exchange can continue and return](../atlas/families/f.md#lossless-exchange-continues-and-returns))*
- **Read backward: what holding it shows** (5 laws). At a step where the dependent is active, the embodied stock it needs at a positive need is active too. *If:* activity needing support; an embodied relatum; a dependence at the step; a positive need; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `Web.Embodied.active_of_bearing`, [Co-ending along dependence](../atlas/families/a.md#co-ending-along-dependence))*
- **The same as, in another model** (6 laws). Under the regime's own step the threshold is H + y, its point of no return, at every recent giving up to the top. *If:* giving rises with what is left; giving short below y; giving meets the draw from y; the band reaches the point; and 3 more. *(enough for it; `RegimeMargin.threshold_regime`, [One law of exact thresholds, and the threshold in the plane of level and recent giving](../atlas/families/a.md#threshold-in-the-state-plane))*
- **If something given were changed** (13 laws). The stock, starting at or above the need, stays at or above it at every step exactly where the draw is within the renewal. *If:* Reoptimizes; exactly r at or above the need; a withdrawal of k; the start meets the need; and 9 more. *(exactly where; of the best of what is open; `Web.course_kept_iff`, [Re-optimizing at every step](../atlas/families/b.md#re-optimizing-above-a-renewal-ends-it))*

<a id="role-renewer"></a>
### what gives back

补给者. What gives to a stock, from inside or from beyond. 1 principal law, from 1 dynamic.

- **What makes it end**. From some step at or after T0 on, the renewer (the sustaining formation) is inactive at every step. *If:* drawing beyond renewal; the sustaining need positive; the focal need within the sustaining need. *(enough for it; `SupportGated.overdraw_ends`, [Loss of renewal for good](../atlas/families/a.md#loss-of-renewal-for-good))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last or change.

<a id="role-drawers"></a>
### the drawers

取用者. What takes from a stock: one, the others, or all together. 4 principal laws, from 4 dynamics.

- **What makes it end** (2 laws). The other drawer is inactive at every step from T plus the stock's level at T on, for good. *If:* TakesAll; f active at every step; living by taking; activity not resumed once stopped; and 8 more. *(enough for it; `Flow.continuing_ends_taker`, [What taking all that is given excludes](../atlas/families/b.md#what-taking-all-excludes))*
- **What cannot happen** (2 laws). Not every member of the first n generations of takers is active at its generation's step; the law names no member and no step. *If:* given nothing; generations at least doubling; active members take; the level short of the doubling; and 4 more. *(enough for it; `LineageRegimes.multiplying_takers_stop`, [Ending laws as regimes on a lineage](../atlas/families/a.md#ending-laws-as-regimes-on-a-lineage))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last or change.

<a id="role-dependent"></a>
### what depends on it

依者. What needs a stock at some level, whether or not it draws on it. 19 principal laws, from 13 dynamics.

- **What makes it end** (15 laws). At each step from T on, a dependent that then needs the stock at m or more is inactive. *If:* activity needing support; below m from T on; a dependence at the step; a need of at least m. *(enough for it; `Flow.ends_below`, [Loss of renewal for good](../atlas/families/a.md#loss-of-renewal-for-good))*
- **What keeps it from beginning**. The dependent does not begin to be active across that step: it does not go from inactive to active. *If:* active exactly where supported, at the step and the next; the requirements kept across the step; the needs stay across the step; every level stays across the step. *(enough for it; `Web.not_arises_of_unchanged`, [Unceasing arising needs renewal](../atlas/families/g.md#unceasing-generation-needs-renewal))*
- **Where the line falls**. Over any stretch of steps from S, the dependent is active at most as often as its reserve at S. *If:* unsupported from a step on; a reserve; and 2 more. *(enough for it; `Web.Carries.lasts`, [A reserve defers the end](../atlas/families/a.md#reserve-defers-ending))*
- **What cannot happen**. The dependent is not active at arbitrarily late steps; no last active step is named. *If:* unsupported from a step on; a reserve. *(enough for it; `Web.Carries.active_not_recurring`, [A reserve defers the end](../atlas/families/a.md#reserve-defers-ending))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, last or change.
- **If something given were changed** (1 law). Each part alone forms at every step; under their joint draw every share of what forms is nothing from the budget step on. *If:* pressure within renewal; pressure beyond the initial rate; a share within what forms; a supplied wear law with no recovery. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `RenewingFormation.jointly_exceeding_parts_end_shared_formation`, [Renewing and consuming formation](../atlas/families/h.md#renewing-consuming-formation))*

<a id="role-rule"></a>
### a rule

规则. What a choosing goes by: a selection, an order over outcomes, a quota, a score. 3 principal laws, from 3 dynamics.

- **What makes it last** (2 laws). Along a course of the declared protocol with no adoption, the rule in force at its end is the rule at its start. *If:* no adoption; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `RuleHandoff.rule_inherited`, [What ungated steps keep; an empty pool stays empty](../atlas/families/a.md#what-a-gate-keeps))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, change or end.
- **If something given were changed** (1 law). A one-step law restores mutual giving and answers a constant withholder exactly where it gives just where the pair's last steps agreed. *If:* a law keeping mutual giving. *(exactly where; of two courses that differ in one thing; `WindowedWaiting.restores_and_answers_iff`, [A pair tolerates only within a window](../atlas/families/e.md#a-pair-tolerates-only-within-a-window))*

<a id="role-selected"></a>
### what it selects among

所选者. What a rule picks among: the carriers of what it favours and the rest, with the share of each. 15 principal laws, from 7 dynamics.

- **What makes it last** (3 laws). From any step, the share is at no later step lower than it was at that step. *If:* rules favouring along the course; Raises. *(enough for it; `RuleCapture.share_kept_along`, [A reading against the share does not ratchet](../atlas/families/c.md#a-reading-against-the-share-does-not-ratchet))*
- **Where the line falls** (9 laws). Across the stretch the shapers' share does not fall exactly where each other's offspring, multiplied over the steps, are at most each shaper's. *If:* the rule after shaping; shapers present at the start; and 3 more. *(exactly where; `RuleShaping.stretch_iff`, [The capacity to shape the rule, selected by what comes back to it](../atlas/families/c.md#shaping-the-rule-selected-by-what-comes-back))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, change or end.
- **If something given were changed** (3 laws). The shapers' share falls strictly at every step of the run, the rule held with nothing coming back to them alone. *If:* the rule after shaping; a positive cost; shapers present at the start; and 3 more. *(enough for it; `RuleShaping.nothing_back_falls`, [The capacity to shape the rule, selected by what comes back to it](../atlas/families/c.md#shaping-the-rule-selected-by-what-comes-back))*

<a id="role-readers"></a>
### its readers

读取者. What a rule or a reading is read through: a pool, a group, the couplings into it. 2 principal laws, from 2 dynamics.

- **What makes it last**. After a supplied step a present reader is still present, whatever the level before the step. *If:* a reader rebuilt from the level; a set level of at least one; the reader present; at least one unit wanted. *(enough for it; `ReaderRebuilding.«供则读者不绝»`, [The stock buys time where the rebuild draws on it](../atlas/families/h.md#the-stock-buys-time-where-the-rebuild-draws-on-it))*
- **What it is unmoved by**. At every step the reader stands in the course of the one act exactly when it stands in the course of the other. *If:* the two acts agree within the group's closure; within the group's closure drawn through both flows; a reader's own standing coupled into it; ExchangeLaw.Through; and 3 more. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `reader_kept_alike`, [A selection read off the pool its own course gives registers no removal](../atlas/families/b.md#selection-read-off-its-own-survivors))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, change or end.

<a id="role-reading"></a>
### a reading

读法. What something holds of what it meets: a view, a prediction, a rank, a code from senses to forms. 12 principal laws, from 10 dynamics.

- **What makes it last** (4 laws). From the first step on the reading rests: the same candidates kept, the same act taken, the same value read at every step. *If:* answered, stays, chosen; unrefuted; and 1 more. *(enough for it; `ReadingLoop.Loop.rests_of_unrefuted`, [What a course chosen through its model does not test](../atlas/families/d.md#what-a-course-chosen-through-its-model-does-not-test))*
- **What keeps it from beginning**. A reading taken from the view that is never false on closed states gives no answer at the settled course's view. *If:* KnowledgeCorrespondence.SoundOn. *(enough for it; `Generative.NormativeActivity.sound_closed_answer_abstains`, [Adaptive closure: a reference changed outside what is retained is not resolved from the view](../atlas/families/d.md#adaptive-closure-cannot-resolve))*
- **What it is unmoved by** (2 laws). From any listing and valuation, filtering by what is shown then revaluing by an input gives the same state as the other order. *If:* decided. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `ListingValuation.updates_commute`, [A reading informed and revalued along one law: the updates commute, the courses do not](../atlas/families/d.md#a-reading-informed-and-revalued))*
- **An order that is kept**. Across every change of amounts, over the family the rises in position total the same as the falls. *(enough for it; of every course of every process; `RelativePosition.change_balances`, [Position does not protect](../atlas/families/b.md#position-does-not-protect))*
- **What cannot happen** (2 laws). A count belief at the free-energy bound for weights a renaming moving every word fixes has no uniquely greatest word. *If:* weights the renaming fixes; the renaming moves every word; a positive total weight; the belief at the free-energy bound; and 1 more. *(enough for it; of the best of what is open; `CountedCodes.minimizer_no_unique_greatest`, [A code held as counts, learned from what is heard](../atlas/families/c.md#a-code-held-as-counts))*
- **Read backward: what holding it shows** (2 laws). A fixed point of the three-valued revision shows some sentence undecided. *If:* two-valued revision with no fixed point; a closed system of sentences; a fixed point of three-valued revision. *(enough for it; `Undecided.undecided_of_moves`, [The liar's revision never rests with two values; with three, from all undecided, it rests undecided](../atlas/families/f.md#revision-with-an-undecided-value))*
- **No law here shows** what makes it begin, change or end.

<a id="anything-that-goes-on"></a>
## Anything that goes on

凡相续者. 102 principal laws name no role: they hold of every course, every process or every relation. 23 dynamics are made of such laws alone: [the list](DYNAMICS.md#anything-that-goes-on).

- **What makes it begin** (5 laws). The courses of the first and the third configuration meet: at some steps they are at one configuration. *If:* the courses meet. *(enough for it; of every course of every process; `Law.Meet.trans`, [Basins of a determined law, one cycle each](../atlas/families/a.md#basins-of-a-determined-law))*
- **What makes it last** (27 laws). Everything that can be had from one configuration can be had from another exactly where the other leads back to the first. *(exactly where; of every course of every process; `keeps_reach_iff_returns`, [Necessarily drawn exactly what does not return](../atlas/families/a.md#necessarily-drawn-is-not-returning))*
- **What makes it change** (6 laws). Some course from the start changes at arbitrarily late steps exactly where a reachable configuration steps to another that can reach it again. *If:* a list holding every configuration. *(exactly where; of every course of every process; `Settling.keeps_changing_iff`, [A run round a loop keeps changing](../atlas/families/f.md#a-run-round-a-loop-keeps-changing))*
- **What makes it end** (10 laws). A configuration is drawn into some region the law never leaves exactly where its course never again is at it, for good. *(exactly where; of every course of every process; `Law.drawn_iff_not_returns`, [Drawn exactly where it does not return](../atlas/families/a.md#attraction-is-not-returning))*
- **What keeps it from beginning** (3 laws). Nothing in the region goes out of it along the relation exactly where what is not outside the region is closed under the relation. *(exactly where; of every course of every process; `«不出当且仅当不外者闭»`, [Not going out of a region](../atlas/families/a.md#not-going-out-of-a-region))*
- **Where the line falls** (2 laws). A level up to the bound has the fate exactly where it is below the length of the check's leading run of true. *If:* a fate down-closed in the level; an exact check; and 1 more. *(exactly where; of every course of every process; `RegimeMargin.leading_exact`, [One law of exact thresholds, and the threshold in the plane of level and recent giving](../atlas/families/a.md#threshold-in-the-state-plane))*
- **What it is unmoved by** (2 laws). At every number of steps, any observable's expectation from the image equals its expectation, read through the map, from the configuration. *If:* Weighted.Commutes. *(enough for it; of two courses that differ in one thing; `Weighted.Commutes.carried`, [What a commuting law keeps apart, and what a learner's symmetry fixes](../atlas/families/d.md#what-a-commuting-law-keeps-apart))*
- **What cannot happen** (18 laws). No step from there is a losing step: after every step from there, that the configuration can still be had cannot be refuted. *If:* a step that keeps s; not a juncture; a step taken. *(enough for it; `Branching.keeps_before_juncture`, [Every loss passes a juncture](../atlas/families/a.md#every-loss-passes-a-juncture))*
- **Read backward: what holding it shows** (10 laws). Not not: some course from the configuration to where it is lost takes a losing step at a juncture for it. *If:* returns, under a process; a trace of the process; cannot be had again. *(enough for it; `Branching.loss_passes_juncture`, [Every loss passes a juncture](../atlas/families/a.md#every-loss-passes-a-juncture))*
- **The same as, in another model** (7 laws). That every line meeting the head law's premise at the activity class reaches an end holds exactly where excluded middle holds. *(exactly where; of every course of every process; `Map.end_of_gone_iff_excluded_middle`, [Degeneration from a horizon](../atlas/families/a.md#degeneration-from-a-horizon))*
- **If something given were changed** (12 laws). Taking only the steps after which the configuration can still be had, it can be had again from wherever the course from it leads. *(enough for it; of every course of every process; `Branching.keeping_keeps`, [Every loss passes a juncture](../atlas/families/a.md#every-loss-passes-a-juncture))*
